ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the load workload, latency objective and the unbounded-duration flag are declared; it does not generate load.
offer: Evaluate capacity under a declared workload and latency objective. Bound the experiment duration and stop conditions before putting pressure on an environment.

minimal.reason: Describe the workload used to size capacity. Capacity against an unspecified load means nothing, so state the request mix and rate.

mid.reason: Set the latency objective in milliseconds, at least 250. A tighter figure cannot be evidenced here, so choose a measurable limit.

maximal.reason: Set unbounded load duration to false. An experiment without a stop time can damage the environment, so bound its length.
